decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is a flagship automation offering for precast concrete plants with long sales cycles, so the firm will keep it to recoup development costs.
The de-shuttering robot is a core module of the firm's precast automation portfolio and shares technology with the other robots, so dropping it would save little.
The profile storage robot complements the shuttering systems as part of an integrated line, and one year is too short to judge its success in a capital goods market.
Automatic shuttering is central to the firm's precast plant automation business and fits the industry demand for labor-saving equipment, so it will remain on the market.
